en.headline: Customs seize about 320000 suspected pharmaceutical products at bridge port
en.dek: An outbound goods vehicle at the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Hong Kong Port was found carrying roughly 320,000 suspected pharmaceutical products valued at about HK$18 million; the Mainland driver faces a court…
body: Hong Kong Customs said officers intercepted an outbound goods vehicle at the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Hong Kong Port on Monday based on risk assessment.

The vehicle was declared to be carrying health products, skincare items and clothing. Upon inspection of the cargo compartment, officers found about 320,000 pieces of suspected pharmaceutical products with an estimated market value of around HK$18 million.

A 39-year-old Mainland male driver suspected of involvement was arrested and charged with one count of attempting to export unmanifested cargo. He is due to appear at the West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts on Tuesday.
Customs noted that smuggling is a serious offence under the Import and Export Ordinance, with a maximum penalty of a fine of HK$2 million and seven years' imprisonment upon conviction.

zh.headline: 海關港珠澳大橋口岸檢獲約32萬件懷疑藥劑製品 市值約1800萬元
zh.dek: 人員根據風險評估截查一輛出境貨車，在貨斗發現約32萬件懷疑藥劑製品，估計市值約1800萬元；39歲內地男司機被控企圖輸出未列艙單貨物，明日提堂。
body: 香港海關表示，周一根據風險評估，在港珠澳大橋香港口岸截查一輛報稱載有保健品、護膚品及服飾等的出境貨車。
經檢查貨斗後，發現約32萬件懷疑藥劑製品，估計市值約1800萬元。
海關拘捕一名39歲懷疑涉案的內地男司機，控以一項企圖輸出未列艙單貨物罪，他將於周二在西九龍裁判法院提堂。
海關指，走私屬嚴重罪行，根據《進出口條例》，任何人輸入或輸出未列艙單貨物，一經定罪，最高可被判罰款200萬元及監禁7年。
